title: Writing statistics
subtitle: See how your work is taking shape.
documentScope: The filter includes the document and its current chapters or subpages.
loadError: Statistics could not be loaded. Please try again.
sessionError: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
activeTimeHint: Recorded time with the editor active
averageHint: Includes inactive days in the period
growthExplanation: Words added measure positive growth when you save. Keystrokes, duplicates and restored versions do not count. Streaks require saved growth; active time alone does not count as an active day.
trackedSince: Tracking available since {{date}}. Earlier activity is not reconstructed.
notTrackedYet: No activity has been tracked yet. Your current content is shown; history begins with your next edits.
emptyTitle: No activity in this period yet
emptyHint: Write and save in the editor to start building your record.
calendarScroll: Daily calendar; scroll horizontally to explore

quotes.q0: A small scene can still move a story forward.
quotes.q1: Return to a sentence and you may find another path.
quotes.q2: Leave an open question for your next session.
quotes.q3: Consistency also means knowing when to rest.
quotes.q4: Today, giving your story a little more space is enough.
quotes.q5: Listen for what your character is not ready to say.
quotes.q6: Revising is writing too: every decision matters.
